answer: A new vertex on the settlement graph opens only after a one-time quarry warrant is burned. The warrant is issued when a lab matches the isotope signature of a hand-cored shale plug to a catalogued relic shard taken from the same bed and held in escrow. The shard is destroyed in the assay, and each surveyed bed is capped at two warrants per season. A copied key cannot reopen a spent warrant, and a sybil farm would have to exhaust real beds and destroy real relics rather than spin up disposable accounts.
